name: Braintrust CLI
desc: Terminal tool for running evals and querying logs as SQL.
desc_zh: 在终端里跑评测、用 SQL 查日志的工具。
solves: Checking a eval result meant opening the web app; the same runs and queries now happen in the terminal where the work already is.
solves_zh: 过去看一次评测结果要打开网页应用；同样的运行和查询现在在终端里就能完成。
best_for: You want an eval to run as part of a script instead of a click in a dashboard.
best_for_zh: 想让评测作为脚本的一步跑起来，而不是去面板上点一下。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — braintrust.dev/blog）。 Installed as `npx bt`. Released before the window and absent from the ledger, so recorded under brief rule (b). 首次公开日期来源：https://www.braintrust.dev/blog/cli-and-mcp
